newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sets Ecu market makers, UBS unit off list.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sets Ecu market makers, UBS unit off list.

text.p: The London International Financial Futures and Options Exchange said on Wednesday it renewed its three-month Ecu interest rate contract market maker scheme, although UBS Futures & Options was no longer on the list.
LIFFE said in a statement Istituto Bancario San Paolo di Torino SpA, Kredietbank NV, NatWest Futures and SGF Chase Futures & Options were still designated market makers.

But a LIFFE spokesperson said UBS Futures & Options, which was on the list when it was last issued in June, was no longer a market maker. LIFFE renewed the scheme until June 16, 1997, the last day of the June 1997 delivery month.
